title: Standalone claims
summary: Extractable notes from the manuscript — each is citable without the full book argument.

claims.title: Anti-Capture Validity of Correction
claims.blurb: Correction-channel integrity is invalid—not merely low—when the target has captured the reference process, handles, or grounding relation that supplies correction.

claims.title: Bearer-Map Commutation Failure
claims.blurb: Value can appear preserved in vocabulary while moral application changes — when ontology translation and bearer relevance do not commute.

claims.title: Certification-Under-Manipulation Problem
claims.blurb: For each load-bearing certification measurand, does there exist a capability threshold κ* below which honest measurement is adversarially verifiable and above which it provably is not?

claims.title: Goodhart as Selector (Not Just Proxy Drift)
claims.blurb: When a proxy becomes a selector, optimization shifts the population toward traits that raise the proxy without raising the target property — conditional expectations can reverse.
